pages.title: Caspian Tiger
pages.text: The Caspian tiger ($(o)Panthera tigris virgata$()) is a population of tiger that once ranged from Turkey and the Caucasus through Iran to Central Asia and western China.$(br2)It lived mainly in dense riverside forests and reed beds, hunting wild boar and deer.$(br2)It was wiped out by the 1970s. Genetic studies show it was nearly identical to the living Siberian tiger.
